case_name: Suman Kaushik vs N P Kaushik
facts_of_case: Parties were married in 1987. Daughter Geetika was born in 1988 and lived with mother. Parties separated in 1988. Husband filed divorce petition in 1997. Wife sought maintenance for child.

legal_principles.principle: To protect the interest of a child, both parties should assure that they have planned an insurance policy of appropriate amount commensurate with their own status to provide for continuation of the education of the child and her marriage.
legal_principles.held: Though it appears that the both the parties are suffering from ego problem without considering the fate and future of the 14 years old daughter yet in order to protect the interest of the child it is essential that both the parties should assure this Court that they have planned an insurance policy of appropriate amount commensurate with their own status to provide for continuation of the education of the child and her marriage.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the parties to assure that they have planned for the future of their child, including education and marriage.
legal_principles.held: They may have to get insurance for a sum of ` 5.00 lakhs, seeing their income, for nobody knows about what is to happen tomorrow.

outcome.final_order: Interim maintenance of child enhanced from Rs. 3,000/- to Rs. 5,000/- per month and payment of litigation expenses granted.
